notes.title: BUBBLE DOGS with more bonuses
notes.content:
Bubble Dogs is evolving with its new style, but not only! Form families of dogs in the window so that they can live together in a house without being separated. As long as there's room in the window, the game continues. If the window is too full, the game ends.


Families ( + 5 pts)

Create families from the 6 dog breeds. Each family includes at least one puppy, one adult male and one adult female. Families are validated when the 3 bubbles of different dogs touch, form a chain or when several bubbles form a group. The family then disappears from the table to make way for the next one.




HEART ( 1 pt )

Generally, when the dogs go to the kennel, the hearts are released and fly away. 1 heart off the screen earns 1 point.



[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2918470/ss_2f63921c54af0bf59e8766fb51aff884cfd8b24e.600x338.jpg?t=1717322711[/img]



BIG LOVE

At the bottom left of the screen, you'll notice a heart counter. When you reach each level, you trigger the great love, which allows all the lonely dogs in the window to leave. That is, those who don't form a duo. The number of points you earn each time is equal to the number of levels reached.



[previewyoutube=DjuoB046oOA;full][/previewyoutube]




[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2918470/ss_03afe6c9aeb3f940a2e4aac18c8524a25633aaad.600x338.jpg?t=1717322711[/img]



POWER DOGS ( 50 pts )

POWER DOGS is triggered when you manage to create all 6 families of each dog breed. It releases all pairs of dogs from the display case and a golden kibble appears.



[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2918470/ss_64efb33eb6aaa76ff84437930c02ba2888098c38.1920x1080.jpg?t=1717322711[/img]



GOLD KIBBLE ( 150 pts )

When you trigger a POWER DOGS, a GOLD KIBBLE appears on the launcher. You can then choose where to release it. Note that if the display window is almost full, the GOLD KIBBLE will fall off by itself.



[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2918470/ss_c336aea9fe686b5b693db47ba2201945967e01d0.600x338.jpg?t=1717322711[/img]



If a puppy of any breed touches a GOLDEN CROQUETTE, it evolves into an adult dog of the same breed, male or female, at random. This will give you an advantage when you have too many puppies. But beware: it can also lead to unpleasant surprises if you don't master its use. When 2 GOLDEN CROKETS touch, a golden paw appears.


GOLDEN PAW ( 500 pts )

When GOLDEN Paws appear, they fall vertically where 2 GOLDEN CROKETS have met. For 5 seconds, he sends any dog he touches to the kennel, earning 10 pts/dog touched.



[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2918470/ss_c0f7502e0ce14e9053c0f96267d1f1e1575b4a23.600x338.jpg?t=1717322711[/img]



When 2 GOLDEN LEGS touch, a bone falls vertically from that point.


BONE ( 1000 pts )

When a bone appears, it falls vertically where 2 GOLDEN Paws have met. It tends to bounce. To retrieve it, simply touch it with a GOLDEN PAD within the first 5 seconds of its appearance. This frees up space in the display case.



[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2918470/ss_5e06ff15eaf5f4e1d57b66b9db2a8fa1a8f1d47a.1920x1080.jpg?t=1717322711[/img]
